one_line: E-commerce platform (now Lightspeed) whose REST API manages products, orders, customers, categories, discounts and store settings.
auth_notes: OAuth2 for public apps or permanent access token for private apps; store id + token used as Bearer on api.ecwid.com endpoints; JS API for storefront cart/checkout events.
self_serve_notes: Free Ecwid plan (up to 5 products) + free dev app registration; a dev can create a store and app, then request a permanent access token without paying.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: REST API covering products, categories, orders, customers, discounts/coupons, store profile, payment/shipping methods, invoices; GraphQL for storefront data; plus JS API and webhooks
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks for product, order, category and profile events delivered to HTTPS endpoints

existing_mcp.note: No official Ecwid MCP server found; community servers not verified

evidence.note: Fetched text confirms Ecwid app API (public/private apps, OAuth flow, webhooks, JS API, storefront/API docs at api-docs.ecwid.com); token details from knowledge

agent_notes: Fetched page is a docs index; free plan + permanent access token makes first call fast. Auth is simple.
